Aspect.description: The IEC 81346 aspect of a structure tree (doc 03 §5).

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

SourceRef.description:
The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

key.description: The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`.

description: One identifier in one aspect tree (doc 03 §5, rank 20).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

aliases.description: Import spellings that map to this node ("JE2416"; a set, sorted); never printed (D-03).

aspect.description:
The aspect tree. `product` is the device tree and never a structure node (doc 03 §5): the strict
reader rejects it and the loader reports it like a malformed known variant.

parent.description: Parent node of the same aspect.

title: structure_node
